answer_1.quote: Our approach utilizes two language models: LM1 as the mnemonic generator and LM2 as the rule generator... we fine-tune LM1 to generate mnemonics...

answer_2.quote: We utilize BERTScore, ROUGE . BERTScore measures semantic similarity between model outputs and human-authored mnemonics, while ROUGE measures lexical overlap.

answer_3.quote: using LLM-as-a-judge, EM is preferred over SFT with a win rate of 58.1%... We prompt GPT-4o to evaluate whether the generated mnemonics adhere to the learned rules by identifying which activated rules are correctly applied.
